external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three partner organisations pushing a daily claims extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

external_entities.name: data analyst
external_entities.description: Internal analyst querying the warehouse directly.

processes.name: ingest scheduler
processes.description: Airflow scheduler that lists the landing bucket nightly and triggers a transform per file. Does not verify which partner a file came from.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.

processes.name: transform job
processes.description: Spark job that normalizes claim records and loads them into the warehouse. Validates schema only.
processes.source_excerpt: the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: Object store receiving partner extracts, one folder per partner.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.technology: object storage with an SFTP front end

data_stores.name: airflow metadata db
data_stores.description: Airflow's own database, holding connection strings and the partner SFTP keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_stores.name: claims warehouse
data_stores.description: BigQuery dataset of normalized claim records, including member names and dates of birth.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: push daily extract
data_flows.description: Partner uploads its daily claims extract into its folder.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each partner has a static key we issued when they onboarded; the keys have not changed since.
data_flows.authentication: static per-partner key issued at onboarding, never rotated
data_flows.data_description: claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: list and read files
data_flows.description: Scheduler lists the bucket nightly and reads every file present, without checking which partner deposited it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

data_flows.name: read connections
data_flows.description: Scheduler reads its connection strings and the partner keys.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger transform
data_flows.description: Scheduler starts one transform run per landed file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
data_flows.data_description: run request naming the file to process

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: Transform writes normalized claim rows into the warehouse.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_flows.name: run queries
data_flows.description: Analyst queries the warehouse under a dataset-wide grant.
data_flows.source_excerpt: they…authenticate with SSO, but the grant is dataset-wide — we have not split member-identifying columns out
data_flows.authentication: company SSO; dataset-wide grant with no column-level restriction

trust_boundaries.name: partner network
trust_boundaries.description: The three partner organisations, outside this system's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: Ingest tier holding the landing bucket, the scheduler and its metadata database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: Analytics tier holding the transform job, the warehouse and its analysts.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network

assumptions.assumption: SFTP traffic from partners is protected by the SSH transport it runs over.
assumptions.basis: The text names SFTP, whose transport encryption is intrinsic to the protocol; no other transport claim is made.

assumptions.assumption: The claims data is health-related personal data.
assumptions.basis: Described as insurance claim records carrying member names and dates of birth.
